targets.title: Fast but ﬂeeting: adaptive motor learning processes associated with aging and cognitive decline.
targets.evidence_quote: Therefore, we set out to measure both implicit adaptation and its retention via spontaneous recovery in a single force-ﬁeld paradigm in both healthy young and older adults to test four different hypotheses, reﬂecting previous research: 1) implicit adaptation levels at the end of the adaptation period are similar across age groups (27), 2) spontaneous recovery is larger in young than in older participants (37), 3) implicit adaptation at the end of the adaptation period is correlated with the amount of spontaneous recovery (45), and 4) as suggested by Trewartha and colleagues, spontaneous recovery is related to explicit memory processes such as working memory capacity.
